producer: PL EMD1 AXIS -> Q30 filter(16ch) + FFT(8 selected channels) -> EDP2 AXIS

packet.cycle_event: paired DRDY frame PHY acceptance; two ADC DOUT streams shift in parallel
packet.timestamp_scope: actual PL digital transport event, not ADC aperture or measured analog group delay
packet.paired_drdy_to_accept_nominal_cycles: 3..4 digital synchronization cycles, metastability not measured
packet.current_cycle_snapshot_registers: CONTROL[3] coherent status snapshot, low0x1a0 high0x1a4 event0x1a8=2 hz0x1ac

emd1.sequence: EMD1 words 2 and 3 must both equal the monotonically wrapping frame sequence
emd1.time_basis: design interval only; not measured ADC timestamps

filtered.format: signed-24 sign-extended in little-endian u32 counts
filtered.record: u32 sequence, u32 per-channel clip bitmap, sixteen s32 samples
filtered.filter_profile: three Q2.30 sections: 0.5 Hz HP, 50 Hz notch, 45 Hz LP
filtered.production_input_channel_order: 0..15 once per frame, at least16 clocks between the same channel
filtered.phase_delay: IIR frequency-dependent group delay unchanged; the15-clock transport latency is not analog sample aperture delay

spectrum.transform: forward radix-2 DIT, complex signed 32-bit, each stage divided by 2; net divide by 2048
spectrum.record: u16 bin, u8 channel, u8 flags=0, s32 real, s32 imag, u32 reserved=0
spectrum.fft_peak_burst_policy: 256-record bounded queue; FFT output stalls under queue-full until EDP2 chunk publication drains records
spectrum.validity: SPECTRUM_VALID is set only for actual completed FFT records; no sentinel records

ownership.reset_or_sequence_gap: set gap/reset flags, flush filter/FFT windows, invalidate spectrum until a full fresh 2048-frame window completes
